notes.2: the left edge continues the neighbouring plaster wall seamlessly: the plaster is at full pale brightness right up to the first pixel column, with no shadow, vignette, groove or darkening along the left edge; it darkens only softly next to the right rubble post

notes.4: one continuous mottled cream plaster face with no vertical lines, cracks or seams anywhere; it darkens only softly next to the right rubble post
notes.5: copy the composition exactly: a narrow column of dark rough rubble stone runs down the right edge and a band of rubble along the top; the cream plaster fills the rest as one continuous face with soft shading, with no lines or seams inside the plaster
